title: Popup Episode Union Dataset item with v1 message profile
description: One popup observation item containing the 90+165 source-field union, a required v1 popup-message judgment profile, and nullable advanced recovery compatibility fields.

action_attempts.description: v1 is strictly action-free; the actionAttempt definition remains only as an advanced compatibility vocabulary for a future profile.

presence.description: Map from a local field name or JSON Pointer to why its value is or is not present.

fieldProvenance.description: Map from local field name or JSON Pointer to provenance descriptors.

pilot_item_id.description: Stable private annotation-pilot join key when this union item originates from the frozen pilot; null or absent otherwise.

messageJudgment.description: Required v1 no-action popup-message judgment profile. These protocol fields are counted separately from the frozen 90+165 source-field union.

gap_ground_truth.description: Independent post-message-gold audit of what the frozen structured representation exposes. It is never method input and does not alter the screenshot-only A/B message labels.
